hero.name: Rariana Aina Andriamiadana
hero.subtitle: I build robust, maintainable web applications — mainly with Java and Spring Boot on the server side, Vue.js and React on the front end.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Driven by building things that work
about.description_1: As a full-stack developer I work across the whole chain, from the data model to the user interface. What I enjoy most is turning a fuzzy business need into a clear, reliable application.
about.description_2: My main ground is the Java ecosystem with Spring Boot, paired with modern front ends in Vue.js and React. I care about readable, tested and documented code, and about well-designed databases.
about.description_3: Away from the editor I follow how the ecosystem evolves, contribute to open source projects, and enjoy sharing what I learn with the community.
